summary: Only data built on complete source data reaches ServiceNow and the workbooks.

fixes.title: Sending checks the data it sends
fixes.text: Before sending, SecurityInsight now checks that the very collection it sends was built on complete source data. If not, nothing is sent, and the next complete run sends what changed.

fixes.title: Held sending shows as a warning
fixes.text: When sending is held, the log now shows a warning with the collection's time and why it was held.
